## History

During her time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), Stella settled into student life alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md). As commencement approached, she maintained these new friendships while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) balanced her academic rivalry and visits with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).
